messages:
Dana Liu: short pulse — can we align on GA acceptance for routing? I sketched must-haves: SLA scope, docs MVP, oncall mapping, telemetry sampling, pricing guardrails. propose narrow GA.
Mark Chen: agree. SLA: "partial" for hosted Tier A only. p99 server-side completion for non-streaming. streaming SLO: p95 per-chunk.
Sofia Ruiz: Docs MVP: Quickstart cURL + SDK, SLA paragraph (measurement query), rollback/runbook excerpt, cost-estimator table. I'll own the SLA paragraph.
Avery Cole: Telemetry: 1% full traces, 5% latency histograms. Alerts: p99 >350ms sustained 5m => P1. Canary: 24h at 5% traffic with auto-rollback on sustained breach.
Mark Chen: example metric query to include in doc: ```percentile_over_time(99, request_latency_ms{route="/v1/gen",status="200"}, "1h")```
contract-bot: Note: Finance prefers "credits subject to contract" phrasing; avoid numeric credits in public docs.
Dana Liu: Commercial stance: soft pricing bands + opt-in quota limits for early customers to avoid bill shock. Zoe from sales wanted that — @Zoe please confirm.
Avery Cole: Oncall routing: Tier A -> infra rotation; Tier B -> product rotation. I'll draft escalation steps.
Sofia Ruiz: Timeline: docs first draft tomorrow 6pm PT. Dana will coordinate commercial blurb with Finance.
deploy-bot: Staging canary rollout completed at 1746000029. No regressions flagged. :white_check_mark:
Dana Liu: Decision: proceed with narrow GA as described. Owners check in 10am tomorrow. Call out any hard blockers here. :thumbsup:
